dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: If I'm to be honest, you're a lot sturdier than I imagined...

dialogues.speaker: Rodamonte
dialogues.text: Assess as you wish. I don't care.

dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: ...Your rationality is most admirable, too. It is something I lack. But I can't help but worry about you — it must be hard, being unable to speak to those around you.

dialogues.speaker: Rodamonte
dialogues.text: I do not wish for their understanding. This is the price of keeping a secret.

dialogues.speaker: Rodamonte
dialogues.text: Also, are you done beating around the bush? Let's get to the meat of the matter. I'm busy.

dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: The meat of the matter... Um...

dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: So, uh, have you found anything else lately?

dialogues.speaker: Renaud
dialogues.text: Well, of course I'd like to see them, too. I mean, I trust your decision-making, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rodamonte
dialogues.text: How did this become my decision? The key is your view. What do you say?
